title: Projects under a budget, crews and regional caps
heading: Whiteboard: Projects Under a Budget, Crews and Regional Caps
cases: a plan within the budget is allowed, and one over it refused
a plan that needs more crew-weeks than there are is refused
a region with more projects than its cap is refused
two conflicting projects together are refused
a needed project may be funded alone, and the one that needs it may not
projects in different regions count against different caps
a region missing from the caps has no cap, and a region with a cap still has one
